title: Find the Maximum Achievable Number
summary: Given two integers, num and t, find the maximum achievable value of x such that x can become equal to num after performing the operation of either increasing or decreasing x and num by 1 at most t times.
statement: Given two integers, num and t, find the maximum achievable value of x such that x can become equal to num after performing the operation of either increasing or decreasing x and num by 1 at most t times.
constraints: In one operation, increase one of num and x by one while decreasing the other by one.
A number x is achievable if it can equal num after exactly t operations.
hints: To maximize x, begin above num.
Each operation can decrease x by one and increase num by one, closing a gap of two.
Therefore the largest initial x is num+2*t.
A larger gap cannot close in t steps, and this construction closes exactly the stated gap.
editorial: A larger gap cannot close in t steps, and this construction closes exactly the stated gap.

tests.explanation: Start x at six; decreasing x and increasing num once makes both five.
Starting x at seven allows the two values to meet after two operations.
